changelog: Live parcel status from Ship24, TrackingMore, AfterShip or EasyPost as well as 17TRACK (setting status_service, 17TRACK by default): Status\ApiProvider sends a Domain\StatusApi (Ship24Format, TrackingMoreFormat, AfterShipFormat, EasyPostFormat, pure and unit-tested from each service's documentation) with the shop's key, spaced to the service's rate and stopping a run after 20 seconds. Each service has its own webhook (/wp-json/creative-tracking/v1/<service>), accepted only with the shop's webhook secret (new setting status_secret, or CTRACKING_STATUS_SECRET; CTRACKING_STATUS_KEY for the key). Ship24's pushes may carry several parcels (Status\MultiPushProvider); EasyPost keeps no tag, so its pushes are matched by tracking number. Filter ctracking_status_carrier for a service's carrier code. Switching service (or key) sends open parcels to the new one (ctracking_status_switched). TrackingMore needs the carrier: a number without a TrackingMore code is refused on the order without a request.

Proof of delivery, stored with a delivered parcel's status in _ctracking_parcels (signed_by, left_at; approved 28 Oct 2026): "Signed for by … Left at: …" (Display::proof()) on the order screen and, for the signed-in customer who owns the order, in My Account. Never on the tracking page, Track an order or in emails; no photos.
Ship orders (with how many wait) and Import tracking as buttons above the orders list (Admin\OrdersScreen).

The shipping report is WooCommerce → Reports → Shipping (woocommerce_admin_reports); the old address redirects there. Ship orders, Import tracking and the report are off WooCommerce's menu; their addresses still work, with Orders highlighted.
Tracking settings in four pages (&view=status, payments, import), each saving only its own fields.
The orders list's Tracking column shows the first parcel and folds the rest under "1 more parcel".
The privacy policy suggestion names the chosen service.
A refused key (401, 403) at AfterShip or EasyPost is an error for the run, so parcels stay waiting until the key is fixed, instead of being closed.
